quests.title: Hammer and Wrench

dialogue.t: (test)思妤啊 呜呜
(test)算了，别管我了，你走吧
(test)让我自己静静
I suppose I should give him a Xiao Lantern after all...
Oh, Traveler, it's you. Well, "The Wrench" has always taken good care of me. Even now, he helps me out all the time — he's almost like a real brother to me.
This is supposed to be a festival, and yet he's still working non-stop...
So, I'd like to give him a Xiao Lantern as a gift. Hehe, we were childhood playmates, and he absolutely loved the sight of the lanterns when he was little.
I'm sure he'd love to get one now. Traveler, could you help me deliver this Xiao Lantern to him?

dialogue.sit: Don't you want to give it to him yourself?
It might mean more coming from you...

dialogue.t: I'd love to, but I've still got so many things to take care of at home...
I've left my husband to do all the housework while I've been out shopping. I should get back to help him out as soon as I can.
So I'm leaving the matter of the Xiao Lantern to you. Once we've got some time, my husband and I will go see "The Wrench" together.
I do hope that he'll manage to get a little more free time...
Hmm? Do you have some business with me, Traveler? I'm quite busy at the moment.

dialogue.sit: Here's a Xiao Lantern from Siyu...

dialogue.t: I do hope that "The Wrench" will like this Xiao Lantern...
Siyu? She... she got me a Xiao Lantern? L—Let me see!
Hahaha, she wrote this wish for me, didn't she? Yep, that was my greatest wish as a kid...
So many years have passed in the blink of an eye. Time truly flies...
Still, how come she asked you to deliver it to me?

dialogue.sit: She has things to attend to at home...
She needs to return home to help her husband...

dialogue.t: Ah, is that so... Good, good. Yes. Very good.
Sounds like she's got a good life now. That's all that matters... Haha... Heh.
It's a good thing. It's very good... I'm sorry, I've still got a lot of work to do. If you'll please excuse me...
That Xiao Lantern was from Siyu, wasn't it?
Hah, I just know him well enough. There was no need to even guess.
He did exactly the same thing last year. Went off for a walk, then came right back and proceeded to hammer nails into a ship's hull the whole night through.
I know why he does this, but still... *sigh*
Traveler, could you please go help him out? Tormenting oneself is no way to spend a festival...
*sigh* Sorry for troubling you.
I bet he's onboard a ship right now, working away... Best you go find him quick.
I'll be preparing some food in a bit. Come back here once you're done and we'll eat together.
We've dallied so long, I'm sure we've fallen behind on work. Best we put our backs into it.
Hey! What are you trying to say? I'm fine! Why wouldn't I be?
I should get back to work now. Once I've finished... *sigh* Well, I'll see.
Hmm? ...Well, if you really want to, you can bring me some wooden planks.
*sigh* Why does he choose to suffer like this...
Have you brought the planks?
Mm, these should do the trick. Many thanks.
There's still a few loose ends to tie up. Could I trouble you to go to the dock and take inventory of some newly arrived goods?
There should be a total of three crates piled up at the dock.
You're a big help. In the meantime, I need to get a move on and finish up everything here...
Have you tallied the numbers up?
Thank you very much!
Well then! That's today's urgent work dealt with.

dialogue.sit: Hammer Li says he's got some food prepped for you.

dialogue.t: Huh? Does he, now? ...That guy worries too much.
Well, whatever. Since he's already gone to the trouble of making it, let's go and join him.
Besides, you helped me out a lot too, so some of that should go to you as compensation.
It's done. I hope I didn't keep you waiting.
Oh, you've finished everything?
Aye. It was a small matter, and with this traveler helping, it was easy.
You... *sigh*
Oh, come on. It's the festive season, no need for the long face.
Yes, sure, whatever you say. Have you prepared a Xiao Lantern yet?
A Xiao Lantern... Ugh, I forgot! What's with my memory today...
Ah well, never mind, eh? It's just a lantern. So what if we don't release one this time?
Hah, don't you try that with me. You're not seriously suggesting that we celebrate the Lantern Rite without a lantern, now, are you?
Traveler, could you make a lantern for my colleague ?
Thank you very much. We'll be waiting for you here.
Did you bring the Xiao Lantern?
I don't really need a Xiao Lantern, honestly, I...
Oh, come on. It's the Lantern Rite. Let's release a lantern and get some of that festive joy in you.
That will do. Thank you.
You've really done a lot, Traveler, and during the festive period, too...
Well then, what should I wish for...
Hmm, let's go with this: "New year, new horizons!"
You think so? Hahaha, that's good... Ah, I do wish that it would come true...
*sigh*
He made the same wish last year as well...
(test)霄灯最重要的就是人的祝福和心意
(test)就是这个啦！麻烦帮我送给王扳子吧！
(test)海灯节还真是热闹啊，我先去忙去了

quests.description: Wrench Wang from Liyue Harbor seems to be looking for help with some matters…
